observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor stage or dance studio with a wooden floor, stage lights, a DJ table with a laptop, and a seated audience surrounding the dance floor. Many people in the audience wear white attire.
observation.dancers: Two couples, consisting of two men and two women (mixed couples), performing as a main group on stage.
observation.formation_and_space: Couples dancing side-by-side or facing each other on a wooden dance floor, occasionally switching partners or positions within the small group.
observation.posture: Upright torsos with fluid upper body movement, soft knees, and continuous weight transfer between feet.
observation.footwork: Stepping side-to-side and forward-backward with weight shifts, including taps on beats, rapid foot replacements, and syncopated steps.
observation.arms_and_hands: Closed and open dance holds, leading and turning partners, with free arms extending outward or framing the body during spins.
observation.hips_and_torso: Noticeable hip movement and hip sways synchronized with the stepping pattern and rhythm of the music.
observation.partnering: Close-contact partnering with frequent turns, dips, spins, and hand-to-hand connections.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent single and multiple turns, dips where one partner leans back supported by the other, and fluid level changes.
observation.costume_and_props: Men wear white shirts and white trousers (one wearing a white suit jacket and fedora), women wear white dresses, white jacket-and-skirt sets, or crop tops with dark skirts, and heels.
observation.cannot_infer: Precise foot placement details are partially obscured by long dresses and rapid turning movements.

signature_moments.what: Couples perform synchronized basic side steps with hip sways and turns in close embrace.
A partnered dip and spin combination where the woman leans backward while supported by the man.
A dramatic low dip where the woman is lowered nearly parallel to the floor before recovering.
A partner switch and simultaneous upper body hair whip while maintaining hold.
